# 觀音經義疏記條箇

**ID:** X0644
**Volume:** X35
**Category:** 法華部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／法華部疏
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0644

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* anonymous *tiáogè* 條箇 (item-by-item topic outline) of the late-Míng combined-edition of [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE)'s Zhīlǐ *Guānyīn yìshū jì* ([KR6d0049](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0049), T1729). Together with the corresponding *kēwén* 科文 sectional analysis ([KR6d0053](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0053)), it provides the topic-index navigational aid complementing the structural-outline approach. The work is preserved as X35n0644 in the *Xùzàngjīng*.

**Abstract**

The *Tiáogè* parallels [KR6d0051](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0051) (the *Xuányì jì tiáogè*) in providing a topic-by-topic navigational aid to the corresponding combined-edition text. Where the *Kēwén* organises the text by hierarchical sectional division, the *Tiáogè* organises it by topical headings drawn from the substantive doctrinal content, allowing readers to locate specific passages by subject without having to navigate the larger structural framework.

The opening topic-list demonstrates the breadth of doctrinal content covered in Zhīlǐ's *Yìshū jì*: textual-critical issues (the comparison of Tiāntái and "ancient master" sectional analyses), Buddhist hermeneutics (the four *siddhānta* exegetical method), nominal exegesis (the bodhisattva names), Tiāntái doctrinal classification (the *yuánjiào* / *tōngjiào* / *biéjiào* / *zàngjiào* fourfold framework), and engagement with Huāyán doctrine (the ten-inexhaustible *dharmaparyāya* of the *Avataṃsaka*).

The dating, like the corresponding *Kēwén*, is most plausibly fixed to the period of the parallel combined-edition project (1628–1629), with the bracket extended to 1700 to allow for late-Míng or early-Qing redactional activity.
